title: GateResult
description: The structured payload every Regatta gate emits (L0–Lx, deterministic or AI). Posted verbatim as a structured PR comment and persisted in regatta.db. Signed by the orchestrator for tamper-evidence.

schema_version.description: Major version of this schema. Bumps are breaking.

gate_id.description: Stable identifier for the gate instance (e.g. 'l0_spec_immutability', 'l4_adversarial', 'custom_license_audit').

gate_kind.description: How this gate produces a verdict. Determines audit-tier (see docs/design.md §Test harness).

pr_sha.description: Full 40-char hex SHA of the PR head commit this verdict was computed against.

base_sha.description: Merge-base used for diff computation (informative; L0 normatively uses git-merge-base).

run_id.description: Stable identifier for this gate run. Re-runs against the same pr_sha produce the same run_id (idempotency key).

verdict.description: pass = no findings of blocking severity; fail = at least one blocking finding; advisory = informational only, never blocks.

blocking.description: Whether this verdict blocks merge. Derived from gate config + verdict. Maintainers see this flag at a glance.

findings.description: Per-issue records. Empty array on pass.

claim.description: What the gate found, in operator-facing English.

remediation.description: Specific change to make. Empty if not actionable.

trap_pattern.description: If this finding maps to a Trap Catalog pattern, the pattern ID (P1–P10).

injection_suspected.description: Set by AI gates when the input diff contains content that looks like a prompt-injection attempt. ALWAYS blocks pending human review when true.

prev_record_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous audit record this writer emitted (JCS-canonicalized). Hash-chains the writer's stream so dropped records become detectable. Empty for the first record.

signature.description: HMAC over the canonicalized JCS-serialized payload (RFC 8785). Verifies the result was produced by this orchestrator and not edited in flight.
